dataset.confidenceNote: Official BIGHIT MUSIC/HYBE/Weverse sources govern calendar data. Surprise-song data is independently corroborated because no official consolidated song ledger was found.

rules.chronology: Sort shows by ISO date ascending; performanceOrder breaks ties only within a show.
rules.firstAppearance: Derived at runtime by scanning completed shows chronologically and marking only the first occurrence of each canonical song title. Do not store or hand-edit a firstAppearance flag.
rules.upcomingSongs: Upcoming shows must keep surpriseSongs as an empty array. Never invent placeholders or titles.
rules.status: completed means the show occurred and song data was checked; upcoming means officially announced but not yet completed at dataset.asOf.
rules.canonicalization: Song titles in surpriseSongs are canonical display keys. Aliases are a presentation/search concern and must not alter chronology.
